correctness.rationale: The scalar quartic is derived exactly from the two infected-class steady-state formulas; the denominator is everywhere positive. Five rational sign witnesses certify four disjoint physical roots and the quartic degree proves exhaustiveness and simplicity. At each root the exact rank-one Jacobian determinant is minus a positive multiplier times the scalar fixed-point derivative. Alternating root signs prove two hyperbolic saddles and two hyperbolic sinks; both trace and determinant sign for sinks are justified algebraically. The disease-free linearization is -I. The attached stdlib rational checker confirms witness inputs and identities. No finite enumeration is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: In homogeneous pure collective-triadic SIS, the nonzero equilibrium equation has at most two solutions; here splitting the population by susceptibility creates two separate stable endemic levels, together with stable disease-free extinction, despite no pairwise infection. This is a robust multistability mechanism with an exact global upper bound and checkable rational witness, relevant to nonlinear contagion tipping points rather than an arbitrary parameter computation. No unverified empirical application or downstream global theorem is claimed.
